title: A busy morning
instructions: Tom bu sabah işlerin nasıl ters gittiğini anlatıyor. Olayların sırasını takip et.

script.speaker: s
script.text: This morning, my alarm didn't ring, so I woke up at eight instead of seven.

script.speaker: s
script.text: I didn't have time for breakfast. I just drank some water.

script.speaker: s
script.text: Then I missed my bus, so I had to take a taxi.

script.speaker: s
script.text: I arrived at work at nine fifteen, fifteen minutes late.

script.speaker: s
script.text: Luckily, my boss was late too!

questions.prompt: What time did Tom wake up?
questions.feedback: Alarm çalmadı; yedi yerine sekizde uyandı.
questions.evidence: I woke up at eight instead of seven.

questions.prompt: How did he go to work?
questions.evidence: I had to take a taxi.
Luckily, my boss was late too!
